label: SA-15(7)
title: Automated Vulnerability Analysis

statement.prose: Require the developer of the system, system component, or system service {{ insert: param, sa-15.07_odp.01 }} to:

children.label: (a)
children.prose: Perform an automated vulnerability analysis using {{ insert: param, sa-15.07_odp.02 }};

children.label: (b)
children.prose: Determine the exploitation potential for discovered vulnerabilities;

children.label: (c)
children.prose: Determine potential risk mitigations for delivered vulnerabilities; and

children.label: (d)
children.prose: Deliver the outputs of the tools and results of the analysis to {{ insert: param, sa-15.07_odp.03 }}.

guidance: Automated tools can be more effective at analyzing exploitable weaknesses or deficiencies in large and complex systems, prioritizing vulnerabilities by severity, and providing recommendations for risk mitigations.

params.label: frequency
guidelines: frequency at which to conduct vulnerability analysis is defined;

params.label: tools
guidelines: tools used to perform automated vulnerability analysis are defined;

params.label: personnel or roles
guidelines: personnel or roles to whom the outputs of tools and results of the analysis are to be delivered is/are defined;
